chapterInfo.content:
11
Gyidie su
1 # 2 Ko 5.7 Na afei gyidie ne adeɛ a yɛn ani da soɔ ho ahotosoɔ ne nnoɔma a yɛnhunu ho adansegyeɛ. 2Na yei mu na tetefoɔ no nyaa adanseɛ pa. 3#Gye 1 Gyidie na yɛde te aseɛ sɛ wiase ahodoɔ wɔde Nyankopɔn asɛm na ɛsiesieeɛ, enti deɛ ani tua firi nnoɔma a ɛnna adie mu na ɛbaeɛ.
Habel
4 # Gye 4.4; Mat 23.35 Gyidie na Habel de bɔɔ afɔdeɛ a ɛso kyɛne Kain deɛ maa Onyankopɔn. Ɛno so na ɔnam nyaa adanseɛ sɛ ɔtene, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn dii n’ayɛyɛdeɛ ho adanseɛ, na ɛno so na sɛ ɔwui mpo a, ɔda so kasa.
Henok
5 # Gye 5.24 Gyidie nti na wɔfaa Henok kɔeɛ na wanhunu owuo; na wɔanhu no, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn bɛfaa no kɔeɛ ntira; na ansa na wɔrebɛfa no akorɔ no, ɔnyaa adanseɛ sɛ ɔsɔ Nyankopɔn ani. 6Na sɛ gyidie nni mu a, obi ntumi nsɔ ani. Na ɛsɛ deɛ ɔba Nyankopɔn nkyɛn no sɛ, ɔgye di sɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na ɔyɛ wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ n’akyiri kwan no katuafoɔ.
Noa
7 # Gye 6.8-9; 6.13-22; Rom 4.20; 3.22; 3.24 Gyidie na deɛ wɔnnya nhunuu ɛho nsɛm baa Noa nkyɛn no, ɔde daa ne ho so siesiee adaka maa ne fie nkwagyeɛ, ɛno so na ɔnam buu wiase fɔ, na ɔyɛɛ gyidie ho tenenee ɔdedifoɔ.
Abraham
8 # Gye 12.1; 12.4 Gyidie na wɔfrɛɛ Abraham no, ɔde setie firi kɔɔ baabi a daakye ɔbɛnya hɔ sɛ agyapadeɛ, na ɔfirii adi a na ɔnnim deɛ ɔrekorɔ. 9#Gye 26.3; 35.12 Gyidie na ɔde kɔyɛɛ ɔhɔhoɔ bɔhyɛ asase no so, sɛ ananafoɔ deɛ soɔ, na ɔne bɔhyɛ korɔ no ara adedifoɔ Isak ne Yakob tenaa ntomadan mu. 10Na ɔtwɛn kuro a ɛwɔ fapem a ne kyekyefoɔ ne yɛfoɔ ne Onyankopɔn.
Sara
11 # Gye 21.2 Gyidie na Sara nso de nyaa ahoɔden nyinsɛneeɛ, ɛberɛ a watra ne nyini mu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbuu deɛ ɔhyɛɛ bɔ no nokwafoɔ. 12#Rom 4.19; Gye 22.17 Enti nso na ɔbaako a ɔwuiɛ mpo woo nnipa a wɔdɔɔso sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma ne mpoano anwea a wɔntumi nkan.
Wɔn nyinaa hwɛɛ soro
13 # Gye 23.4; 47.9 Gyidie so na yeinom nyinaa wuwuiɛ a wɔn nsa anka bɔhyɛ no, na mmom wɔhunuu akyirikyiri nko gye diiɛ, yɛɛ no atuu kaa sɛ, wɔyɛ ahɔhoɔ ne amamfrafoɔ wɔ asase so. 14Na wɔn a wɔka saa no, wɔde kyerɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ kuro bi a ɛbɛyɛ wɔn ara wɔn dea. 15Na sɛ wɔn akoma da deɛ wɔfiri mu baeɛ no so a, anka wɔwɔ akwannya sɛ wɔbɛsane akɔ hɔ. 16#Eks 3.6 Na afei wɔrehwehwɛ kuro a ɛyɛ kyɛne soɔ a ɛne ɔsoro deɛ. Enti ɛnyɛ Onyankopɔn aniwu sɛ wɔbɛfrɛ no wɔn Nyankopɔn, ɛfiri sɛ wasiesie kuro bi ama wɔn.
Wɔsɔɔ Abraham gyidie hwɛe
17 # Gye 22 Gyidie nti na wɔsɔɔ Abraham hwɛeɛ no, ɔde Isak kɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ, na deɛ ɔgyee bɔhyɛ no, de ne ba korɔ no kɔmae. 18#Gye 21.12 Ɔno na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Isak mu na wɔbɛfrɛ w’asefoɔ. 19#Rom 4.17 Ɔsusuu sɛ Onyankopɔn bɛtumi anyane no afiri awufoɔ mu mpo. Ɛhɔ nso na ɔnyaa no bio, akasabebuo mu.
Isak, Yakob ne Yosef
20 # Gye 27.28-29; 27.39-40 Gyidie na Isak de hyiraa Yakob ne Esau, nnoɔma a ɛbɛba ho. 21#Gye 48.15-16; 47.31 Gyidie na Yakob rebɛwuo no, ɔde hyiraa Yosef mma baanu no, na ɔmiaa ne pomatire so sɔree. 22#Gye 50.24 Gyidie na Yosef regyae ne honhom mu no, ɔde bɔɔ Israel mma fire a wɔrebɛfiri akɔ no din, na ɔhyɛɛ ne nnompe ho samanseɛ.
Amram ne Yokebed
23 # Eks 2.2 Gyidie na wɔwoo Mose no, n’awofoɔ de koraa no abosome mmiɛnsa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔhunuu sɛ abɔfra no ho yɛ fɛ, na wɔansuro ɔhene mmara no.
Mose
24 # Eks 2.11-12 Gyidie nti na Mose nyiniiɛ no, wampɛ sɛ wɔfrɛ no Farao babaa ba, 25na ɔyii sɛ ɔne Nyankopɔn man bɛhunu amane mmom kyɛne sɛ ɔbɛte bɔne mu dɛ nna tiaa bie. 26#Heb 13.13; 10.34-35 Ɔbuu Kristo ahohora sɛ ahonya kɛseɛ senee Misraim ahonyadeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhwɛɛ akatua no. 27#Eks 2.15; 12.51 Gyidie nti na ɔgyaa Misraim hɔ, na wansuro ɔhene abufuo, na mmom ɔmiaa n’ani tenaa mu sɛdeɛ ɔhunu deɛ wɔnhunuu no no. 28#Eks 12.12-13 Gyidie na ɔde dii Twam ne mogyapete no, na mmakan no sɛefoɔ no anka wɔn.
Israelfoɔ
29 # Eks 14.22; 14.27 Gyidie na wɔde twaa Mmɛwa Po no sɛ fam a awoɔ. Ɛno na Misraimfoɔ resɔ ahwɛ no, ɛmenee wɔn. 30#Yos 6.20 Gyidie nti na Yeriko afasuo a wɔtwaa ho hyiaa nnanson no dwiriiɛ.
Rahab
31 # Yos 2.11-12; 6.17; 6.23; Yak 2.25 Gyidie nti na odwamamfoɔ Rahab a ɔgyee akwansrafoɔ no asomdwoeɛ soɔ no ansɛe amfra wɔn a wɔannye annie no mu.
Agyidifoɔ a aka no
32 # Ate 6.11; 4.6; 15.20; 12.7 Na ɛdeɛn na menka bio? Na sɛ mereka Gideon, Barak, Samson, Yefta, Dawid ne Samuel ne adiyifoɔ no ho asɛm a, anka adagyeɛ bɛbɔ me. 33#Ate 14.6; 1 Sa 17.34-35; Dan 6.22 Wɔn na wɔnam gyidie so ko dii ahennie ahodoɔ so nkonim, dii asɛntenenee, nyinyaa bɔhyɛ, sii agyata ano, 34#Dan 3.23-25 dumm ogya tumi, dwanee nkrantɛ ano, nyaa ahoɔmmerɛ mu ahoɔden, yɛɛ ɔko mu ahoɔdenfoɔ, kaa ananafoɔ mpasua guiɛ. 35#1 Ah 17.23; 2 Ah 4.36 Mmaa nsa kaa wɔn awufoɔ a wɔasɔreɛ; na ebinom nso, wɔde wɔn goroo atɔprɛ, na wɔampɛ ɔgyeɛ, na wɔn nsa aka owusɔreɛ a ɛyɛ kyɛne soɔ. 36#Yer 20.2; 37.15; 38.6 Na afoforɔ hunuu animguasedeɛ ne ɔhweɛ, mpokyerɛ ne afiase nna nso. 37#2 Be 34.21 Wɔsii wɔn aboɔ, de sradaa paee wɔn mu, sɔɔ wɔn hwɛɛ, de nkrantɛ kunkumm wɔn. Wɔkyinii nnwanten ne mmirekyie nwoma mu, ɛhiaa wɔn, wɔn ho dwanee wɔn, wɔhunuu amane. 38Wɔn a wɔnsɛ wiase, wɔkyinkyinii ɛserɛ so, ne mmepɔ so, abodan ne asase so abɔn mu. 39Na yeinom nyinaa a wɔnam gyidie so nyaa adanseɛ pa no, wɔn nsa anka bɔhyɛ no, 40ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn asiesie biribi a ɛyɛ kyɛne soɔ asie yɛn, na wɔankwati yɛn anyɛ wɔn pɛ.

Na afei gyidie ne adeɛ a yɛn ani da soɔ ho ahotosoɔ ne nnoɔma a yɛnhunu ho adansegyeɛ. Na yei mu na tetefoɔ no nyaa adanseɛ pa. Gyidie na yɛde te aseɛ sɛ wiase ahodoɔ wɔde Nyankopɔn asɛm na ɛsiesieeɛ, enti deɛ ani tua firi nnoɔma a ɛnna adie mu na ɛbaeɛ.

Gyidie na Habel de bɔɔ afɔdeɛ a ɛso kyɛne Kain deɛ maa Onyankopɔn. Ɛno so na ɔnam nyaa adanseɛ sɛ ɔtene, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn dii n’ayɛyɛdeɛ ho adanseɛ, na ɛno so na sɛ ɔwui mpo a, ɔda so kasa.

Gyidie nti na wɔfaa Henok kɔeɛ na wanhunu owuo; na wɔanhu no, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn bɛfaa no kɔeɛ ntira; na ansa na wɔrebɛfa no akorɔ no, ɔnyaa adanseɛ sɛ ɔsɔ Nyankopɔn ani. Na sɛ gyidie nni mu a, obi ntumi nsɔ ani. Na ɛsɛ deɛ ɔba Nyankopɔn nkyɛn no sɛ, ɔgye di sɛ ɔwɔ hɔ, na ɔyɛ wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ n’akyiri kwan no katuafoɔ.

Gyidie na deɛ wɔnnya nhunuu ɛho nsɛm baa Noa nkyɛn no, ɔde daa ne ho so siesiee adaka maa ne fie nkwagyeɛ, ɛno so na ɔnam buu wiase fɔ, na ɔyɛɛ gyidie ho tenenee ɔdedifoɔ.

Gyidie na wɔfrɛɛ Abraham no, ɔde setie firi kɔɔ baabi a daakye ɔbɛnya hɔ sɛ agyapadeɛ, na ɔfirii adi a na ɔnnim deɛ ɔrekorɔ. Gyidie na ɔde kɔyɛɛ ɔhɔhoɔ bɔhyɛ asase no so, sɛ ananafoɔ deɛ soɔ, na ɔne bɔhyɛ korɔ no ara adedifoɔ Isak ne Yakob tenaa ntomadan mu. Na ɔtwɛn kuro a ɛwɔ fapem a ne kyekyefoɔ ne yɛfoɔ ne Onyankopɔn.

Gyidie na Sara nso de nyaa ahoɔden nyinsɛneeɛ, ɛberɛ a watra ne nyini mu, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbuu deɛ ɔhyɛɛ bɔ no nokwafoɔ. Enti nso na ɔbaako a ɔwuiɛ mpo woo nnipa a wɔdɔɔso sɛ ɔsoro nsoromma ne mpoano anwea a wɔntumi nkan.

Gyidie so na yeinom nyinaa wuwuiɛ a wɔn nsa anka bɔhyɛ no, na mmom wɔhunuu akyirikyiri nko gye diiɛ, yɛɛ no atuu kaa sɛ, wɔyɛ ahɔhoɔ ne amamfrafoɔ wɔ asase so. Na wɔn a wɔka saa no, wɔde kyerɛ sɛ wɔhwehwɛ kuro bi a ɛbɛyɛ wɔn ara wɔn dea. Na sɛ wɔn akoma da deɛ wɔfiri mu baeɛ no so a, anka wɔwɔ akwannya sɛ wɔbɛsane akɔ hɔ. Na afei wɔrehwehwɛ kuro a ɛyɛ kyɛne soɔ a ɛne ɔsoro deɛ. Enti ɛnyɛ Onyankopɔn aniwu sɛ wɔbɛfrɛ no wɔn Nyankopɔn, ɛfiri sɛ wasiesie kuro bi ama wɔn.

Gyidie nti na wɔsɔɔ Abraham hwɛeɛ no, ɔde Isak kɔbɔɔ afɔdeɛ, na deɛ ɔgyee bɔhyɛ no, de ne ba korɔ no kɔmae. Ɔno na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Isak mu na wɔbɛfrɛ w’asefoɔ. Ɔsusuu sɛ Onyankopɔn bɛtumi anyane no afiri awufoɔ mu mpo. Ɛhɔ nso na ɔnyaa no bio, akasabebuo mu.

Gyidie na Isak de hyiraa Yakob ne Esau, nnoɔma a ɛbɛba ho. Gyidie na Yakob rebɛwuo no, ɔde hyiraa Yosef mma baanu no, na ɔmiaa ne pomatire so sɔree. Gyidie na Yosef regyae ne honhom mu no, ɔde bɔɔ Israel mma fire a wɔrebɛfiri akɔ no din, na ɔhyɛɛ ne nnompe ho samanseɛ.

Gyidie na wɔwoo Mose no, n’awofoɔ de koraa no abosome mmiɛnsa, ɛfiri sɛ wɔhunuu sɛ abɔfra no ho yɛ fɛ, na wɔansuro ɔhene mmara no.

Gyidie nti na Mose nyiniiɛ no, wampɛ sɛ wɔfrɛ no Farao babaa ba, na ɔyii sɛ ɔne Nyankopɔn man bɛhunu amane mmom kyɛne sɛ ɔbɛte bɔne mu dɛ nna tiaa bie. Ɔbuu Kristo ahohora sɛ ahonya kɛseɛ senee Misraim ahonyadeɛ, ɛfiri sɛ ɔhwɛɛ akatua no. Gyidie nti na ɔgyaa Misraim hɔ, na wansuro ɔhene abufuo, na mmom ɔmiaa n’ani tenaa mu sɛdeɛ ɔhunu deɛ wɔnhunuu no no. Gyidie na ɔde dii Twam ne mogyapete no, na mmakan no sɛefoɔ no anka wɔn.

Gyidie na wɔde twaa Mmɛwa Po no sɛ fam a awoɔ. Ɛno na Misraimfoɔ resɔ ahwɛ no, ɛmenee wɔn. Gyidie nti na Yeriko afasuo a wɔtwaa ho hyiaa nnanson no dwiriiɛ.

Gyidie nti na odwamamfoɔ Rahab a ɔgyee akwansrafoɔ no asomdwoeɛ soɔ no ansɛe amfra wɔn a wɔannye annie no mu.

Na ɛdeɛn na menka bio? Na sɛ mereka Gideon, Barak, Samson, Yefta, Dawid ne Samuel ne adiyifoɔ no ho asɛm a, anka adagyeɛ bɛbɔ me. Wɔn na wɔnam gyidie so ko dii ahennie ahodoɔ so nkonim, dii asɛntenenee, nyinyaa bɔhyɛ, sii agyata ano, dumm ogya tumi, dwanee nkrantɛ ano, nyaa ahoɔmmerɛ mu ahoɔden, yɛɛ ɔko mu ahoɔdenfoɔ, kaa ananafoɔ mpasua guiɛ. Mmaa nsa kaa wɔn awufoɔ a wɔasɔreɛ; na ebinom nso, wɔde wɔn goroo atɔprɛ, na wɔampɛ ɔgyeɛ, na wɔn nsa aka owusɔreɛ a ɛyɛ kyɛne soɔ. Na afoforɔ hunuu animguasedeɛ ne ɔhweɛ, mpokyerɛ ne afiase nna nso. Wɔsii wɔn aboɔ, de sradaa paee wɔn mu, sɔɔ wɔn hwɛɛ, de nkrantɛ kunkumm wɔn. Wɔkyinii nnwanten ne mmirekyie nwoma mu, ɛhiaa wɔn, wɔn ho dwanee wɔn, wɔhunuu amane. Wɔn a wɔnsɛ wiase, wɔkyinkyinii ɛserɛ so, ne mmepɔ so, abodan ne asase so abɔn mu. Na yeinom nyinaa a wɔnam gyidie so nyaa adanseɛ pa no, wɔn nsa anka bɔhyɛ no, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn asiesie biribi a ɛyɛ kyɛne soɔ asie yɛn, na wɔankwati yɛn anyɛ wɔn pɛ.
